SITES-COHOMOLOGY-053.argument: The diagram at 10215-10217 fixes the primes unambiguously. Pullback reverses the morphism arrows: Lh* extends coefficients from underline(B) to underline(B'), and Lf* extends B to B'. Consequently the printed Lpi! after Lh* has the wrong input coefficient ring; the printed Lpi'! before Lf* likewise has the wrong output coefficient ring. Exchanging pi and pi' in line 10220 makes both composites functors D(underline(B)) -> D(B'). The first is left adjoint to h_* composed with pi'^{-1}; the second is left adjoint to pi^{-1} composed with f_*. These right adjoints agree: both form the constant sheaf and restrict B'-scalars to B. Restriction of scalars and the constant-sheaf pullbacks here are exact. Uniqueness of left adjoints therefore proves the corrected natural isomorphism. The source's equality notation may remain as its established canonical-isomorphism convention.
